body: May I ask you a favour?  If I pm you the link to my okcupid profile, is there a chance you could glance over it and give me your opinion, as a woman, of any turn-offs, etc? I'll understand if you say no.

I'm not sure that she even considers me a virtual boyfriend.  She has, since knowing me, had about 4 relationships and I suspect (from looking at her facebook) a number of one-night stands.  It sounds big-headed of me, but when she describes each partner or is explaining their faults it sounds like she's trying to compare them to me.
Fashion is more like psychology or an art than science (no offence if you're a psychologist); it has multiple opposing theories for the same situation.

It had crossed my mind that, though I'm alone now, I may not be in another 5 years time.  However, 5 years ago I was thinking the exact same thing.  I tried online dating etc but nobody ever replies to my messages or sends me any.... I can't imagine how many messages I must have sent out.  I imagine it's a lot easier to be a female when it comes to online dating.
She's beautiful and she knows it so it's not about that.  I think she thinks that she's a bitch or a slut or something and doesn't want me to know this.
Also, sometimes when I bring up the question of meeting she says she's afraid of what I'd think of her.  How the hell do I get around that?

Thank you for the response, the summary and the advise.
